  A suspend function is not assignable to a non-suspend function type.
tluaSuspendFunctionTypeErrors.tlua(16,5): error TLUA2345: Argument of type 'suspend (url: string) => boolean' is not assignable to parameter of type '(url: string) => boolean'.
  A suspend function is not assignable to a non-suspend function type.


==== tluaSuspendFunctionTypeErrors.tlua (2 errors) ====
    // Strict suspend assignability: a suspend function is not assignable to a plain
    // (non-suspend) function type. This closes the laundering hole — suspend-ness can
    // no longer be silently erased by annotating a sync function type.
    
    declare function request(url: string): boolean;
    
    suspend function fetchOk(url: string): boolean
      return request(url);
    end
    
    // Error: suspend fn laundered through a plain (sync) function-typed slot.
    local bad: (url: string) => boolean = fetchOk;
          ~~~
!!! error TLUA2322: Type 'suspend (url: string) => boolean' is not assignable to type '(url: string) => boolean'.
!!! error TLUA2322:   A suspend function is not assignable to a non-suspend function type.
    
    // Error: suspend fn passed to a specific sync-typed callback parameter.
    declare function run(cb: (url: string) => boolean): void;
    run(fetchOk);
        ~~~~~~~
!!! error TLUA2345: Argument of type 'suspend (url: string) => boolean' is not assignable to parameter of type '(url: string) => boolean'.
!!! error TLUA2345:   A suspend function is not assignable to a non-suspend function type.
